manifest_note: This manifest is an IMMUTABLE reference artifact. It was created at Phase 7 freeze time with actual SHA-256 hashes of the production data structures. The runtime freeze gate loads this manifest and compares current hashes against these values. The runtime NEVER self-baselines. If the manifest is missing, the gate fails closed. If any hash mismatches, the gate raises F1OptimizationForbidden. This manifest itself is committed to git — modifying it produces a different git commit, which is externally detectable.
